description: Join the numbers and get to the 2048 tile! A classic addictive puzzle game where you slide tiles on a 4x4 grid.
instructions: Use your arrow keys or swipe to move the tiles. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one! Reach 2048 to win.

title: Snake
description: The classic arcade game. Guide your snake to eat the apples and grow longer.
instructions: Use Arrow Keys to control the snake. Eat red apples to grow. Don't hit the walls or your own tail!

title: Tetris Clone
description: Stack the blocks, clear the lines. A pixel-perfect clone of the world's most famous puzzle game.
instructions: Left/Right Arrows to move, Up Arrow to rotate, Down Arrow to soft drop. Space for hard drop. Complete lines to score.

title: Pong
description: The game that started it all. Battle against the computer in this classic table tennis simulator.
instructions: Use your mouse or touch to move your paddle up and down. Deflect the ball past the opponent to score.

title: Breakout
description: Destroy the wall, collect power-ups, and don't let the ball fall.
instructions: Move your mouse or finger to slide the paddle. Keep the ball in play and break all the bricks to clear the level.

title: Minesweeper
description: Clear the grid without hitting a mine! Use logic to flag the dangers.
instructions: Left-click to reveal a square. Right-click to flag a potential mine. Numbers tell you how many mines are adjacent.

title: Tic Tac Toe
description: The ultimate quick match. Challenge the computer to a classic game of Xs and Os.
instructions: Click any empty square to place your mark. Get three in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) to win.

title: Memory Match
description: Test your focus! Find all the pairs of matching pixel cards as fast as you can.
instructions: Click a card to reveal it. Click another to find its match. Remember positions to clear the board efficiently.

title: Space Invaders
description: Defend the earth from waves of descending aliens! Classic shoot-em-up action.
instructions: Use Left/Right Arrows to move your ship. Press Space to fire. Shoot the aliens before they reach the bottom.

title: Hextris Lite
description: Rotate the hexagon to clear blocks of the same color.
instructions: Use Left/Right Arrows to rotate the center hexagon. Match 3 or more blocks of the same color to clear them.

title: Connect Four
description: Drop your discs into the slots and try to be the first to get four in a row.
instructions: Click on a column to drop your colored disc. Get four of your discs in a line horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win.

title: Sudoku
description: The classic number-placement puzzle. Fill the 9x9 grid with digits.
instructions: Click a cell and type a number from 1 to 9. Each row, column, and 3x3 subgrid must contain each number exactly once.

title: Checkers
description: Classic board game of strategy. Capture all of your opponent's pieces.
instructions: Click a piece to select it, then click an empty diagonal square to move. Jump over opponent pieces to capture them.
